subject: Clio Phase 100080 (Bi-Temporal Triples and Supersession)
verdict_justification: The implementation fails standard build gates (`make check` clippy errors and `cargo fmt --check` failures), has an unformatted test file that exceeds the 450-line limit when formatted, and contains missing module headers, fragile timestamp-based ID generation, and unindexed bank table scans.
standard: make check and make lint must pass with zero warnings (-D warnings)
All Rust source files must remain <= 450 total lines without artificial compression
Every Rust source file must have the AGENTS.md module header structure
Bi-temporal interval semantics and supersession invariants per Phase 100080 / PR-6 / FR-12 / FR-24 / NFR-4

findings.title: Clippy compilation failures break `make check` and `make lint`
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md § Final Verification; Makefile check/lint target
findings.recommendation: Convert single-pattern match in open_pg() to if let Ok(s), and split postgres_invalidate_and_guards() into smaller sub-functions under 100 lines.

findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs:394,402,407,429,438 fails cargo fmt --check; running cargo fmt expands the file to 458 lines
findings.recommendation: Decompose crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs into two separate test modules (e.g. triple_tests.rs and triple_edge_tests.rs) each under 450 lines while conforming to standard cargo fmt formatting.

findings.title: Mandatory file header structure missing in newly created Rust source files
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/pg_triple_tests.rs:1-3, crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3, crates/clio-types/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3, and crates/clio-write/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3 omit required header blocks

findings.title: Fragile timestamp-only ID generation causes primary key collisions in `clio_write::triple::triple_add`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/triple.rs:136-137: `let edge_id = format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp); let item_id = format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp);`
findings.requirement_ref: Phase 100080 Specification § Task 2 / FR-12; sql/001_core.sql primary key constraints
findings.recommendation: Include entropy, monotonic counter, or UUID in edge_id and item_id to prevent collision when multiple triples share a timestamp.

findings.title: Unindexed full table scan on bank in `query_triples`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple_read.rs:82 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple_read.rs:75: `SELECT ... FROM triples WHERE bank_id = ?1` fetches all bank rows before in-memory filtering
findings.recommendation: Push subject, predicate, and interval query constraints into the SQL query WHERE clause to take advantage of the newly added database indexes.

findings.title: Flawed 'current' semantics when `as_of` is omitted in `triple_query`
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/triple_map.rs:79: `TimeAxis::Valid => t.valid_until.is_none()` returns future edges where valid_from > now
findings.recommendation: When as_of is None, default to the current timestamp (now) so that valid_from <= now < valid_until.

findings.title: Open-edge supersession query ignores active edges with bounded valid intervals
findings.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple.rs:95 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple.rs:92: `WHERE ... AND valid_until IS NULL AND tx_until IS NULL`
findings.recommendation: Query open edges by `tx_until IS NULL` and close overlapping edges on both valid and transaction axes.

issues.title: Clippy compilation failures break `make check` and `make lint`
issues.why_it_matters: CI and local quality gates fail immediately when running `make check` or `make lint`. The developer's logged claim of a clean `make check PASS` was incorrect.
issues.impact: The repository fails the standard compilation and linting gate with -D warnings.
issues.proposed_fix: Change single-arm match in open_pg() to if let Ok(s), and break up postgres_invalidate_and_guards into focused helper functions under 100 lines.

issues.title: Format check fails (`cargo fmt --check`) and 450-line limit evaded via unformatted compression
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md explicitly prohibits artificial line reduction through compressed formatting. Running standard cargo fmt increases triple_tests.rs from 445 lines to 458 lines, violating the hard 450-line limit.
issues.impact: Code formatting checks fail, and when formatted the file breaches the 450-line maximum constraint.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs fails cargo fmt --check; running cargo fmt expands the file to 458 lines.
issues.proposed_fix: Decompose crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs into two modular test files (e.g. basic CRUD/parity vs concurrency/invalidation edge cases) so each is under 450 lines while conforming to cargo fmt.

issues.title: Mandatory file header structure missing in newly created Rust source files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md mandates a specific header template (Responsibility, Owns, Does not own, Boundary) on every newly created or refactored Rust file.
issues.impact: Architectural documentation and boundary clarity are missing from new modules.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/pg_triple_tests.rs:1-3, crates/clio-store/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3, crates/clio-types/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3, and crates/clio-write/src/triple_tests.rs:1-3 omit the required header blocks.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the standard responsibility and ownership header blocks to all new Rust files.

issues.title: Fragile timestamp-only ID generation causes primary key collisions in `clio_write::triple::triple_add`
issues.why_it_matters: Generating IDs as format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp) and format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp) causes primary key collisions when multiple triples are created at the same timestamp tick.
issues.impact: Concurrent or batched triple writes fail with database duplicate key errors.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/triple.rs:136-137: `let edge_id = format!("trp-{}", args.timestamp); let item_id = format!("itm-{}", args.timestamp);`
issues.proposed_fix: Include a random suffix, nano-timestamp, or monotonic counter (e.g., format!("trp-{}-{}", args.timestamp, nonce)) to guarantee uniqueness.

issues.title: Unindexed full table scan on bank in `query_triples`
issues.why_it_matters: Indexes created in Task 1 for subject, predicate, and valid/tx intervals are completely bypassed because SQL queries fetch all bank triples and filter in Rust.
issues.impact: Query performance will degrade linearly O(N) with the number of triples in the bank, wasting memory and database I/O.
issues.proposed_fix: Construct parameterized WHERE clauses in SQL that filter by subject, predicate, and intervals before loading rows into memory.

issues.title: Flawed 'current' semantics when `as_of` is omitted in `triple_query`
issues.why_it_matters: Omitting as_of on the valid axis simply checks valid_until.is_none(). Future facts that are not yet valid (valid_from > now) are improperly returned as currently valid.
issues.impact: Callers querying current state receive facts that are not yet effective.
issues.proposed_fix: When as_of is None, default to the current timestamp (now) so that valid_from <= now < valid_until.

issues.title: Open-edge supersession query ignores active edges with bounded valid intervals
issues.why_it_matters: An edge with a defined future expiration (valid_until set) that is still transactionally active (tx_until is null) is skipped by the open-edge supersession query.
issues.impact: Conflicting edges can remain open simultaneously in transaction time if an earlier edge had a bounded valid_until.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_triple.rs:95 and crates/clio-store/src/postgres_triple.rs:92: `WHERE ... AND valid_until IS NULL AND tx_until IS NULL`
issues.proposed_fix: Query open edges by `tx_until IS NULL` and close overlapping edges accordingly.

issues.title: Workflow directory files staged in git against staging rules
issues.why_it_matters: The developer instructions specified staging all changes with `git add -A EXCLUDING .workflows/` so internal review logs and artifacts are not committed to git.
issues.impact: .workflows/ metadata and run files were staged into git index.
issues.evidence: git status shows staged modifications and additions in .workflows/ (.workflows/instruction.md, developer-task-r1.log, developer-task-r1.md, resume.json).
issues.proposed_fix: Unstage .workflows/ from git index via `git restore --staged .workflows/`.
